[[File:Dark_Jedi_Starship.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Remulus Dreypa's starship being pursued by Jedi starfighters]]
The '''Dark Jedi Starship''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by a party of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] led by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] that crash-landed on the remote planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Following the establishment of the first [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] in the [[Stygian Caldera]] during the aftermath of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] circa [[6900 BBY]], Dreypa sought revenge against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that had exiled them. He and several other Dark Jedi acquired a starship capable of interstellar travel and used it to travel out of the Stygian Caldera. However, they were intercepted by a Jedi patrol who pursued them across [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

The pursuit ended on Kesh when the Dark Jedi starship crashed on Kesh's surface. Dreypa and his followers survived the crash and fought their Jedi pursuers, devastating much of Kesh's surface and disrupting the lives of the indigenous [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives. Due to Kesh's strong magnetic field, the Jedi were unable to call for reinforcements or leave the planet. During the fighting, Dreypa unleashed several weapons including the [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]], monstrous [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] that drain people's life energies. These events would be remembered by the Keshiri as the [[Great Calamity]] who regarded the Dark Jedi and their Jedi foes as the [[Destructors]] and [[Skyborn|Protectors]] respectively.

In the end, the Dark Jedi made peace with their Jedi adversaries after imprisoning Dreypa within an [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]] where he would remain for nearly four millennia. The two Force organizations then retreated to Kesh's frozen southern continent of [[Eshkrene]] where they established a new community known as [[the Doomed]] who were dedicated to finding true neutrality in the Force. While the destruction of the Dark Jedi Starship deprived Kesh's inhabitants of any form of hyperspace-capable [[Starship/Legends|starships]], a secret [[Last Hope (Jedi starship)|Jedi starship]] was hidden beneath the [[Circle Eternal]] in [[Tahv]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s capital on [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]]. It survived until the events of [[Dreypa's rebellion]] in [[2974 BBY]].
